diagnostic.title: A stale acknowledgement dies, a stale answer is carried over
diagnostic.description: Reproduces the 2026-09-11 stale acknowledgement and adds the answer of the same past intent: a transient speech whose moment has passed is never spoken, while a durable answer (result, error, question) is carried over onto the current intent and delivered.

metrics.name: speech.superseded_count
metrics.description: Candidates superseded or expired during the run.

metrics.name: speech.stale_delivered_count
metrics.description: Transient candidates (progress, acknowledgement) started or completed after a newer intent had reached the scheduler.

metrics.name: speech.carried_over_delivered_count
metrics.description: Durable candidates (result, error, question) of a past intent that were still spoken, carried over onto the current intent.

metrics.name: speech.latest_intent_delivered
metrics.description: The candidate of the latest intent epoch was delivered.

metrics.name: speech.stale_wait_ms
metrics.description: How long a candidate stayed queued past the arrival of a newer intent.

metrics.name: scenario.expectations_declared
metrics.description: Scenario expect.* steps this run evaluated.

metrics.name: scenario.expectations_failed_count
metrics.description: Scenario expect.* steps the run evaluated and did not meet.

assertions.description: A progress or acknowledgement whose moment has passed is never spoken.
An answer of a past intent is still spoken instead of dying in the queue.
The answer of the latest intent is the one delivered.
Every expectation the scenario states about this situation held.

scenario.title: Stale acknowledgement and carried-over answer behind a busy output
scenario.description: An acknowledgement queued behind a playing output while a later turn revises the intent, and the answer of that same past intent arriving once the current turn has been answered: the acknowledgement dies with its moment, the answer is carried over and still spoken.

reported.fact: A ready acknowledgement waited 35900 ms before output.

derived.fact: A superseded candidate must not become spoken at the historical delay.
A durable answer (result, error, question) of a past intent is still spoken unless the brain withdraws it.

constructed.fact: Intent epochs, identifiers, and the 28000 ms supersession point are synthetic.
The late durable candidate old-result of the past intent, and its 36000 ms arrival, are synthetic.
